def by_length(arr):
    if not arr:
        return []
    
    filtered_sorted = sorted(x for x in arr if 1 <= x <= 9)
    reversed_sorted = filtered_sorted[::-1]
    
    number_names = ["One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine"]
    
    return [number_names[x - 1] for x in reversed_sorted]
